snapshots.label: fixed-cohort-before-results
snapshots.input_selection: git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard; existing files only; root Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, crates/** and xtask/** .rs/.toml plus crates/**/locales/**, scripts/** .py/.sh
snapshots.digest_algorithm: Sort unique relative paths lexicographically. Concatenate path UTF-8, NUL, lowercase hex SHA256(file bytes), newline for each file. SHA256 the concatenation. Documentation, build artifacts, fixture state and credentials are excluded.
snapshots.source_mutation_policy: Root reported source frozen for the fixed gate runner. This digest was captured while that runner was active, before its full workspace result. Cohort association relies on that freeze attestation; no direct matching completion digest was captured.
snapshots.after_results_note: Root confirmed the fixed runner fully exited before applying the one-line COMMAND_TEST_LOCK correction. This after-results hash was captured after that authorized source change; its mismatch does not indicate an edit during the runner. The original cohort had a digest captured during the reported source freeze, but no direct matching completion digest was captured.

snapshots.digest_algorithm: Sort unique relative paths lexicographically. Concatenate path UTF-8, NUL, lowercase hex SHA256(file bytes), newline for each file. SHA256 the concatenation. Documentation, build artifacts, fixture state and credentials are excluded.
snapshots.source_mutation_policy: Root explicitly acknowledged all Rust and scripts frozen before the corrected runner. No source/default-exposure edits are allowed until runner completion and a matching after-result digest check. Documentation changes are excluded.
snapshots.coverage: All ten corrected gates and both final real Host/Linux and install-consent opt-ins completed before this after-check; source/default edits remained frozen.
